screen.no_entry: Fill in the Music Assistant ID in the plugin's settings

app.name: Music deck
app.summary: Your Music Assistant playlists on the screen: filter them, pick a speaker, tap to play.
app.input_entry_hint: Settings > Devices & services > Music Assistant: the entry's ⋮ menu, Copy ID (or the end of its page's address).
app.kind_hint: What the list holds from your Music Assistant library.
app.filters_hint: The chips above the list, in this order. None chosen: All, Favorites and Recent.
app.contains_hint: Leave empty for everything, or a word such as Metal to keep only those.
app.speakers_hint: More Music Assistant players to choose from on the tile, beside its own.
app.enqueue_hint: What happens to the speaker's queue.
app.enqueue_replace: Plays it now, in place of the queue
app.enqueue_play: Plays it now, keeps the queue
app.enqueue_add: Adds it to the end of the queue
